description: This file defines the routing for social media post-related API endpoints using Express.js, including create, delete, retrieve, comment, like, unlike, and list operations.

methods.name: router.post "/"
methods.description: Creates a new post with authentication.

methods.name: router.delete "/:id"
methods.description: Deletes a post by ID with authentication.

methods.name: router.get "/:id"
methods.description: Retrieves a post by ID without requiring authentication.

methods.name: router.get "/by/:username"
methods.description: Lists posts by username without requiring authentication.

methods.name: router.get "/explore"
methods.description: Fetches explore posts without requiring authentication.

methods.name: router.get "/search"
methods.description: Searches posts based on query parameters.

methods.name: router.post "/:id/comments"
methods.description: Adds a comment to a post with authentication.
